## bijection_verdict

**PASS.** No atom unborne, none borne with changed meaning, no claim without a structured source; every factor ladder carried in full with figures; retired surface correct. First revision; no previous revisions.

Policy-side notes (not KB verdicts):
1. `delivery_ext_distance_settlement` rule sentence "Because the reduced per-mile fee is never below $0.60 ..." is a source sentence that only holds through the $0.90 tier of the purchase_size_mile_rate factor (level fees floor at $1.25 − $0.30 = $0.95); rendered faithfully inside the Plus-reduction factor document, where it implicitly reflects another factor's ladder. Its origin is the source rule.
2. The overwrite retiring "At booking the following are charged, each as its own entry dated the booking date ..." is declared by every extended policy, leaving base-delivery and stair-carry entry dating with no in-force clause; and the retired base haul-away clause is replaced only for installation appointments, so haul-away on Room of Choice / White Glove / TV levels (e.g. this task's existing haul_away entries) has no in-force charging rule. The KB renders the source exactly as declared.
